data.description:
## Description

**What**: Add a Phase 1.5 hook to /dso:brainstorm that detects whether the in-progress epic touches UI copy, tags the epic `copy-needed`, and writes a `## Copy Needs` section into the epic description conforming to the Copy Needs schema.
**Why**: Without detection at brainstorm time, downstream preplanning cannot auto-create a copy story; copy work would remain ad-hoc.
**Scope**:
- IN: brainstorm detector for UI-copy signals; tag write; `## Copy Needs` section write; user confirmation of detector findings during dialogue; idempotency on re-run
- OUT: preplanning auto-creation of the copy story (separate story); gov-copy-writer agent (separate story)

## Done Definitions

- When this story is complete, running /dso:brainstorm on an epic that contains UI-copy signals results in the epic carrying the `copy-needed` tag
  ← Satisfies: sc-1
- When this story is complete, the same brainstorm run writes a `## Copy Needs` section into the epic description that passes the schema validator
  ← Satisfies: sc-1
- When this story is complete, each Copy Needs item written by brainstorm carries stable_id, type, location, page, and validation rule populated
  ← Satisfies: sc-1
- When this story is complete, running /dso:brainstorm on an epic with no UI-copy signals leaves the epic without the tag or section
  ← Satisfies: sc-1
- When this story is complete, unit tests written and passing for all new or modified logic

## Considerations
- [UX] User confirms detector findings during dialogue rather than the section being silently appended.
- [Idempotency] Re-running brainstorm on the same epic does not duplicate the section or items.

## Escalation Policy

**Escalation policy**: Proceed unless a significant assumption is required to continue — one that could send the implementation in the wrong direction. Escalate only when genuinely blocked without a reasonable inference. Document all assumptions made without escalating.
data.title: As a stakeholder using /dso:brainstorm, I see UI-copy needs detected and recorded on my epic
